Specification: This specification models a single-state-variable system in which the variable fun is initialized to the value of Gen(4) and never changes afterward. The purpose of the module, as indicated by the comments, is to capture a bug related to function generators producing counterexamples with junk values despite an apparently sound internal SMT representation. The spec checks a simple invariant stating that the domain of the generated function is not the empty set, and it has no explicit fault model, fairness constraints, or liveness properties.
